bio: Software engineer (AI & ML, class of 2026) building **backend services, LLM applications** (RAG, agents, MCP) and **data pipelines**.

Right now I'm a **Data Engineer Intern at Zemoso Technologies**, building Python/FastAPI services on AWS and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines. Before that, I did quantum ML research at AnantWave and app development at Prayana Electric.

items: LLM APIs (Claude, Bedrock, Gemini, OpenAI SDK, Groq, Ollama)

points: Build and maintain backend services and REST APIs (Python, FastAPI, SQL) for AI-driven, data-processing applications deployed on AWS.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins to automate builds and deployments.
Write and maintain automated test suites (Selenium, Cypress) for web applications.
Worked with Kubernetes and Terraform at a foundational level to understand project infrastructure.
Implemented a song recommendation search based on Grover's quantum search algorithm (Spotify data) and benchmarked it against classical baselines.
Developed authentication, real-time availability tracking and geolocation for a production e-bike rental app, in a 4-person team.
Led student ML projects for the university Machine Learning Club.

projects.title: Hearth: Family Memory for Alexa+
projects.description: An MCP server that turns Alexa+ into a shared family journal: speaking practice for kids, a daily log for parents with pattern detection and Q&A, and a memoir mode for grandparents. Family Threads pass stories between generations, a family-table mode handles several speakers, and a weekly Family Radio recap sums it up. Privacy, consent and child-safety rules are enforced in code.

projects.title: PerplScope
projects.description: Real-time analytics and risk dashboard for the Perpl perpetuals exchange on Monad. An indexer rebuilds trades from on-chain events to show PnL, drawdown, win rate, liquidation price, a leaderboard and a compare view. It also ships a MetaMask Agent Wallet CLI plugin and agent skill with a pre-trade risk gate, eth_call simulation, a liquidation guard and JSON output for agents.

projects.title: SwasthyaGrid AI
projects.description: Medicine-supply platform for primary health centres. Time-series demand forecasting (lag and rolling features, Ridge with Gradient Boosting on residuals, recursive 7-day forecasts) feeds stock-out risk levels, redistribution suggestions and outbreak simulation, with a Gemini copilot for plain-language questions. Tested with pytest.

projects.title: Tripster
projects.description: Agent-native trip planner. 0/1 knapsack time-blocking plus 2-opt TSP routing plans a trip in under 100 ms, a minimax midpoint finds fair meeting spots for groups, and WebMCP browser tools let an agent plan trips and update the live UI. A PostgreSQL trigger auto-verifies spots, and the whole stack runs at $0/month.

projects.title: Product Price Tracker
projects.description: Daily scraping ETL on scheduled GitHub Actions, writing to a normalised PostgreSQL schema (products, listings, price history) with duplicate-alert prevention. Sends an email when a price drops and charts history in React.

projects.title: Financial Tracker via SMS
projects.description: MacroDroid fires on every bank SMS and calls a webhook API that parses and categorises the transaction into PostgreSQL. Tracks savings, spending and balance, reconciles monthly against bank-statement PDFs, and shows it all on a React dashboard.

projects.title: Gym Equipment App
projects.description: Flutter app that identifies gym equipment from the camera, on-device, and suggests exercises and workout plans.

projects.title: Gym Equipment Detection Model
projects.description: The model pipeline behind the gym app: GroundingDINO auto-annotation, Albumentations augmentation, EfficientDet-Lite0 transfer learning, mAP evaluation, and fp16/int8 quantization with a speed-vs-accuracy benchmark.

projects.title: Real-time AI Assistant Backend
projects.description: Bi-directional WebSockets with LLM token streaming, an agentic tool-calling loop against the database, async persistence, and LLM-generated session summaries as memory.

projects.title: Agentic Workflow Engine
projects.description: An async graph engine for agent workflows, in the spirit of a mini LangGraph: conditional and cyclic routing, typed Pydantic state, a node registry, swappable stores, a max-steps circuit breaker and WebSocket step streaming. The demo is a code-review agent with a review-and-improve loop.

projects.title: RAG Document Reader
projects.description: Chunks and embeds PDF and DOCX files into a FAISS index, retrieves the top passages and answers questions with a local Llama 2.

projects.title: Product Recommendation System
projects.description: Scraped Amazon product data across five categories into MongoDB. Natural-language search with a budget and filters returns the k nearest products, backed by aspect-based review sentiment with a fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3.

projects.title: Song Recommendation using Grover
projects.description: Grover's quantum search applied to Spotify song recommendation, benchmarked against classical baselines.

projects.title: ATS Resume Checker & Builder
projects.description: Parses resume PDFs, extracts skills and scores the resume against a job description with TF-IDF cosine similarity. The builder uses Flan-T5 to polish experience and write a summary, then renders one of three templates to PDF.

projects.title: Fruit & Vegetable Classifier
projects.description: A CNN trained on 36 classes of fruits and vegetables, with accuracy and loss curves and a Streamlit app.

projects.title: Quantum Binary Classifier
projects.description: A hybrid quantum-classical binary classifier on Fashion-MNIST.

projects.title: Bengali Voice Translator
projects.description: Recognises Bengali speech, translates it to English and speaks the result aloud.

projects.title: Binance Futures Trading Bot
projects.description: Places market, limit and stop-limit orders on the Binance Futures testnet, with validation, error handling, logging and a Dockerfile.

projects.title: StackBot Agent
projects.description: An agent that recommends a tech stack for a project idea.

projects.title: Data Hub
projects.description: A data-pipeline dashboard UI built with atomic design, with component unit tests, coverage reports and Storybook.

projects.title: Jenkins Learning Pipeline
projects.description: A declarative Jenkins pipeline: checkout, checks, a Python ETL run and archived artifacts.

projects.title: Docker Practice
projects.description: A multi-container app (Flask web service plus Redis) with connection retries.
